old_caption: The video showcases an intricate domino setup arranged on a wooden floor. The dominoes form a complex spiral pattern, with some sections highlighted by green dominoes. A hand holding a small tool is seen at the beginning, carefully positioning or adjusting the dominoes. As the video progresses, the dominoes begin to fall in a chain reaction, starting from the top left corner and moving clockwise around the spiral. The sequence captures the dominoes' movement in a fluid motion, creating a mesmerizing visual effect. The camera remains stationary throughout, providing a clear overhead view of the entire setup, allowing viewers to follow the dominoes' path as they cascade through the spiral. The video concludes with the dominoes continuing their fall until the end of the spiral, leaving a trail of toppled dominoes behind them.

caption: The video showcases a top-down view of an elaborate domino arrangement of upright clothespins laid out in a wide spiral on a light wooden floor. Most of the spiral and its radial spokes are white, while one upper arc is green and an inner arc pale cream, with a small S-shaped loop at the center. At the far left a separate short run of pins forms a straight line and a coiled loop, and a yellow trigger stick with a red tip rests near loose blue pieces at the lower-left. A fixed watermark sits at the bottom-left corner. The camera and wood-grain background stay identical from first frame to last. Throughout the excerpt the standing pins, colored arcs, and central loop hold their positions without toppling. No collapse front moves through the visible layout, so the clip shows the fully set-up arrangement held in place.
